items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: That was the last time Lawrence played out there with us.

ctx.x: Yeah, baby used to have to do that and after you had it, you couldn't move it fast.

No, I noticed that because he had wrestled me up several times at the hunt club in Chicago. He used to come there and ask about the wrestling up. I said, man, I said, you're doing me all the good in the world. I said, they sit out in that audience and look at you sitting up on my drums. I said, it makes me feel good, baby. One night I cried, I'm telling you the truth. I really broke down and cried, you know, to see how he was up there fighting, you know, to try to get his arms in shape, you know. And I said,…
